newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose 56.57 points to 6,935.46. PLDT's ADR gained $0 3/4 to $60.
* The peso closed lower at 26.334 to the dollarvs 26.323
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index fell 26.45 points to 3,234.79.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was at 10.03125 from 10.28125 percent.
